o: A byl den připravování, a sobota se začínala.
t: Now it was the day of Preparation, and the Sabbath was beginning.

o: Šedše pak také za ním ženy, kteréž byly s Ježíšem přišly od Galilee, pohleděly na hrob, a kterak pochováno bylo tělo jeho.
t: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee also sat opposite the tomb, and looked at how his body was buried.

o: Vrátivše se pak, připravily vonné věci a masti, ale v sobotu odpočinuly, podle přikázání.
t: And having returned, they prepared spices and ointments, and rested on the Sabbath, according to the commandment.

o: První pak den po sobotě, velmi ráno vyšedše, přišly k hrobu, nesouce vonné věci, kteréž byly připravily, a některé jiné byly spolu s nimi.
t: But on the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they went out with their spices and came to the tomb, and some other women were with them.

o: I nalezly kámen odvalený od hrobu.
t: And they found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

o: A všedše tam, nenalezly těla Pána Ježíše.
t: And when they came there, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.

o: I stalo se, když ony se toho užasly, aj, muži dva postavili se podle nich, v rouše stkvoucím.
t: And as they were amazed there about this, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments.

o: Když se pak ony bály, a sklonily tváři své k zemi, řekli k nim: Co hledáte živého s mrtvými?
t: And when they were afraid and bowed their faces to the ground, the men said to them, "Why do you seek the living among the dead?"

o: Neníť ho tuto, ale vstalť jest. Rozpomeňte se, kterak mluvil vám, když ještě v Galilei byl,
t: He is not here, but he has risen. Remember how he spoke to you when he was still in Galilee,

o: Řka: Že Syn člověka musí vydán býti v ruce hříšných lidí, a ukřižován býti, a třetí den z mrtvých vstáti.
t: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, be crucified, and rise again on the third day.

o: I rozpomenuly se na slova jeho.
t: And they remembered his words.

o: A navrátivše se od hrobu, zvěstovaly to všecko těm jedenácti učedlníkům i jiným všechněm.
t: And they returned from the tomb and told all these things to the eleven disciples and to all the others.

o: Byly pak ženy ty: Maria Magdaléna a Johanna a Maria matka Jakubova, a jiné některé s nimi, kteréž vypravovaly to apoštolům.
t: Now the women were Mary Magdalene and Joanna and Mary the mother of James, and some other women with them, who reported these things to the apostles.

o: Ale oni měli za bláznovství slova jejich, a nevěřili jim.
t: But their words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they did not believe them.

o: Tedy Petr vstav, běžel k hrobu, a pohleděv do něho, uzřel prostěradla, ana sama leží. I odšel, divě se sám v sobě, co se to stalo.
t: But Peter rose and ran to the tomb, and looking in, he saw only the linen cloths lying there. And he went away, marveling to himself at what had happened.

o: A aj, dva z nich šli toho dne do městečka, kteréž bylo vzdálí od Jeruzaléma honů šedesáte, jemuž jméno Emaus.
t: And behold, two of them were going that day to a village sixty furlongs distant from Jerusalem, whose name was Emmaus.

o: A rozmlouvali vespolek o těch všech věcech, kteréž se byly staly.
t: And they were talking together of all these things which had happened.

o: I stalo se, když rozmlouvali a sebe se otazovali, že i Ježíš, přiblíživ se k nim, šel s nimi.
t: And it came to pass, as they talked and questioned one another, that Jesus himself drew near and went with them.

o: Ale oči jejich držány byly, aby ho nepoznali.
t: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.

o: I řekl k nim: Které jsou to věci, o nichž rozjímáte vespolek, jdouce, a proč jste smutní?
t: And he said to them, "What are these things of which you speak with one another as you walk? And why are you sad?"

o: A odpověděv jeden, kterémuž jméno Kleofáš, řekl jemu: Ty sám jeden jsi z příchozích do Jeruzaléma, ještos nezvěděl, co se stalo v něm těchto dnů?
t: And one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answered him, "Are you the only one of those coming to Jerusalem who has not learned what has happened there in these days?"

o: Kterýmžto on řekl: I co? Oni pak řekli jemu: O Ježíšovi Nazaretském, kterýž byl muž prorok, mocný v slovu i v skutku, před Bohem i přede vším lidem,
t: And he said to them, "What things?" And they said to him, "Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, who was a prophet, mighty in word and deed before God and before all the people,

o: A kterak jej vydali přední kněží a knížata naše na odsouzení k smrti, i ukřižovali jej.
t: and how our chief priests and rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.

o: My pak jsme se nadáli, že by on měl vykoupiti lid Izraelský. Ale nyní tomu všemu třetí den jest dnes, jakž se to stalo.
t: But we had hoped that he would redeem Israel. And now, it is the third day since all this happened.

o: Ale i ženy některé z našich zděsily nás, kteréž ráno byly u hrobu,
t: But some women from our company astounded us; they came to the tomb early in the morning,

o: A nenalezše těla jeho, přišly, pravíce, že jsou také vidění andělské viděly, kteřížto praví, že by živ byl.
t: and when they found his body absent, they came back saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.

o: I chodili někteří z našich k hrobu, a nalezli tak, jakž pravily ženy, ale jeho neviděli.
t: And some of our companions went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said, but they did not see him.

o: Tedy on řekl k nim: Ó blázni a zpozdilí srdcem k věření všemu tomu, což mluvili Proroci.
t: Then he said to them, "O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken!"

o: Zdaliž nemusil těch věcí trpěti Kristus a tak vjíti v slávu svou?
t: Was it not necessary for the Christ to suffer these things and enter into his glory?"

o: A počav od Mojžíše a všech Proroků, vykládal jim všecka ta písma, kteráž o něm byla.
t: And beginning from Moses and all the prophets, he explained to them all the scriptures that concerned him.

o: A vtom přiblížili se k městečku, do kteréhož šli, a on potrh se, jako by chtěl dále jíti.
t: And as they drew near to the village to which they were going, he acted as though he meant to go farther.

o: Ale oni přinutili ho, řkouce: Zůstaň s námi, nebo se již připozdívá, a den se nachýlil. I všel, aby s nimi zůstal.
t: But they compelled him, saying, "Stay with us, for it is getting late, and the day is far spent." And he went in to stay with them.

o: I stalo se, když seděl s nimi za stolem, vzav chléb, dobrořečil, a lámaje, podával jim.
t: And it came to pass, as he sat at the table with them, that he took bread, blessed it, broke it, and gave it to them.

o: I otevříny jsou oči jejich, a poznali ho. On pak zmizel od očí jejich.
t: And their eyes were opened, and they recognized him. And he vanished from their sight.

o: I řekli vespolek: Zdaliž srdce naše v nás nehořelo, když mluvil nám na cestě a otvíral nám písma?
t: And they said to one another, "Did not our heart burn within us as he spoke to us on the way and opened the scriptures to us?"

o: A vstavše v tu hodinu, vrátili se do Jeruzaléma, a nalezli shromážděných jedenácte, a ty, kteříž s nimi byli,
t: And rising up in that same hour, they returned to Jerusalem and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,

o: Ani praví: Že vstal Pán právě, a ukázal se Šimonovi.
t: who said, "The Lord has truly risen, and he has appeared to Simon."

o: I vypravovali oni také to, co se stalo na cestě, a kterak ho poznali v lámání chleba.
t: And they also related what had happened on the way, and how he had been recognized in the breaking of the bread.

o: A když oni o tom rozmlouvali, postavil se Ježíš uprostřed nich, a řekl jim: Pokoj vám.
t: And as they were talking about these things, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them and said to them, "Peace be with you."

o: Oni pak zhrozivše se a přestrašeni byvše, domnívali se, že by ducha viděli.
t: But they were startled and terrified, thinking they were seeing a spirit.

o: I dí jim: Co se strašíte a myšlení vstupují na srdce vaše?
t: And he said to them, Why are you afraid, and why do thoughts enter your heart?

o: Vizte ruce mé i nohy mé, žeť v pravdě já jsem. Dotýkejte se a vizte; neboť duch těla a kostí nemá, jako mne vidíte míti.
t: Look at my hands and my feet, for it is I myself. Touch me and see; for a spirit of flesh and bones does not have, as you see me having.

o: A pověděv to, ukázal jim ruce i nohy.
t: And as he spoke, he showed them his hands and his feet.

o: Když pak oni ještě nevěřili pro radost, ale divili se, řekl jim: Máte-li tu něco, ješto by se pojedlo?
t: And while they yet believed not for joy, but marvelled, he said to them, Have you here anything to eat?

o: A oni podali jemu kusu ryby pečené a plástu strdi.
t: And they gave him a piece of broiled fish and a honeycomb.

o: A vzav to, pojedl před nimi,
t: And he took it and ate before them.

o: A řekl jim: Tatoť jsou slova, kteráž jsem mluvil vám, ještě byv s vámi: Že se musí naplniti všecko, což psáno jest v Zákoně Mojžíšově a v Prorocích i v Žalmích o mně.
t: And he said to them, These are the words which I spoke to you while I was yet with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the Psalms, concerning me, must be fulfilled.

o: Tedy otevřel jim mysl, aby rozuměli Písmům.
t: Then he opened their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures.

o: A řekl jim: Že tak psáno jest a tak musil Kristus trpěti, a třetího dne z mrtvých vstáti,
t: And he said to them, Thus it is written, and thus it must be that Christ should suffer, and the third day rise from the dead,

o: A aby bylo kázáno ve jménu jeho pokání a odpuštění hříchů mezi všemi národy, počna od Jeruzaléma.
t: And that remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

o: Vy jste pak svědkové toho.
t: And ye are witnesses of these things.

o: A aj, já pošli zaslíbení Otce svého na vás. Vy pak čekejte v městě Jeruzalémě, dokudž nebudete oblečeni mocí s výsosti.
t: And behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you. And ye shall wait in the city of Jerusalem until ye be clothed with power from on high.

o: I vyvedl je ven až do Betany, a pozdvih rukou svých, dal jim požehnání.
t: And he led them out as far as Bethany, and lifted up his hands and blessed them.

o: I stalo se, když jim žehnal, bral se od nich, a nesen jest do nebe.
t: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, that he was taken up from them, and carried into heaven.

o: A oni poklonivše se jemu, navrátili se do Jeruzaléma s radostí velikou.
t: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy.

o: A byli vždycky v chrámě, chválíce a dobrořečíce Boha. Amen.
t: And they were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
